overview_description.description: Flockjay connects startups with sales professionals and educates job seekers through remote learning. Flockjay provides training and support for in-demand tech jobs and provides final round interviews for high-paying jobs at top companies. The company's mission is to make tech accessible for people from underrepresented communities.
